primary_task: A Synder user with Shopify and QuickBooks sets up inventory sync so that Shopify stock follows QuickBooks quantities, and then keeps it running.
observations: first visit: 1 open step(s); step states ["step-1:is-open","step-2:is-locked","step-3:is-locked","step-4:is-locked","step-5:is-locked"]
Check again always succeeds in the prototype; the "setting still not changed" branch is not built

Words such as "storefront", "tune", "link", "check", "warning", "priority_high", "open_in_new", "place", "link_off", "compare_arrows" in state text are Material Icons ligatures — they render as icons, not as visible words.
Toasts ("Settings opened in a new tab.", "… connected.") stand in for real navigation/feedback in the prototype.
